[h2]"Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?" is back![/h2]

In anticipation of the new DLC question packs (coming soon!), we've updated the following features:

• Thanks to your help, we've fixed several errors that appeared in the answers to the questions in the original game
• It is now possible to select just 1 question pack to play (instead of the previous minimum of 4) 
• Multiplayer lobbies have been reduced from 100 to 50 players to facilitate their creation. 

Thank you for your loyalty and staunch support!

Already available: 
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729730/Who_Wants_to_Be_a_Millionaire__Season_Pass/]Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? - Season Pass[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635190/Who_Wants_To_Be_A_Millionaire__US_Movies_90s_DLC_Pack/]Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 90s DLC Pack[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: The DELUXE UPGRADE DLC is available now!
notes.content:
What is being said about the first DLC for Who Wants to be a Millionaire?

A: That it’s packed with content
B: That it’s available now on consoles and PC
C: That it’s fun for all
D: All of the above

This DLC’s extra content includes:
[list]
[*] More than 3,000 new questions, for a grand total of 8,000 questions!
[*] New question packs to put your knowledge about the Olympic Games or the Justice League to the test!
[*] An option to remove the timer allowing everyone to take the time they need to submit their final answer!
[*] A new “quick game” mode focusing only on questions and answers letting players reach the million faster!
[*]  Enhanced models and animations immersing all contestants even more into the real game show!
[/list]
